issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning a String, but the intended implementation (shown in the solution) and the natural numeric semantics use an int. This contradiction can confuse students because the task text explicitly tells them to check the UML for the expected return type; students may implement a String-returning method (or format the number as a String) while the reference solution and likely tests expect an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Update problem_statement.md (UML and any descriptive text) so getTotalNumberOfStudents() is declared to return int (not String). Alternatively, if the intention is to return a String, change the solution and template implementations to return String and update examples accordingly. Preferred fix: change the UML to getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and adjust the example to show numeric values without quotes.
